manual_review_reason: KVRX explicitly directs all music submissions for airplay consideration to music@kvrx.org and states that both digital and physical submissions are currently accepted. Its official policy also states that AI-assisted or AI-generated music will not be considered. A human must verify that the selected MarcsMusic track contains no AI-assisted or AI-generated elements, confirm current digital attachment-versus-link instructions, formats, file-size limits, metadata, international eligibility, release timing and explicit-content requirements, and submit only once through the Music Department route. Do not use operations, programming, booking, newsletter, login, social or physical routes as duplicates or workarounds.
